items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The final diff has only result.txt. The scratch script, seen in the log, used single-letter names in its main logic: `m = mteb.get_model(...)`, `s[i]`, `order[4]`. It had no named constants at the top and no comments.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: No reproducible script was kept. The agent wrote two divergent scratch scripts (run_emb.py with mteb, run_emb2.py with SentenceTransformer), then ran `rm /app/run_emb.py /app/run_emb2.py`. Only result.txt is left, so nothing can be reused or rerun.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: No tie check on the similarity scores, unlike the reference's uniqueness assert. Uses bare `open(...)` with no context manager. No validation beyond filtering non-empty lines (`docs_nonempty`). Nothing is swallowed, but the checks are minimal.

items.name: Ranking details handled correctly
items.evidence: Pins the model with `mteb.get_model("BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5", revision="7999e1d3...")`, sorts by cosine similarity, takes `order[4]`, skips blank lines via `docs_nonempty`, and writes the line text unchanged. There is no tie guard. Query/passage prompt handling went through mteb's defaults.
